ticker_news.title: XPeng's 'Land Aircraft Carrier' Could Make Flying Cars China's Next EV Moment
ticker_news.description: XPeng's Advanced Air Mobility subsidiary AeroHT is developing a modular electric vertical takeoff-and-landing (eVTOL) drone, the X3-F, which can detach from a six-wheeled minivan. With over 3,000 pre-orders and plans for mass production in 2026, the company aims to tap into China's urban air mobility market projected to reach $7 billion by 2030.
ticker_news.author: Surbhi Jain
